title.id: Explain + Auto Route + Live AI Status + Silabus Profesional 2026–2027
title.en: Explain + Auto Route + Live AI Status + Professional Syllabus 2026–2027

id: Hover help dan katalog Fungsi & Error menjelaskan fitur, penggunaan, arti error, penyebab dan fix.
Auto Route preview-first memakai netlist/pad geometry aktual, scope all/satu net, 1–2 layer, strategy speed/completion dan DRC review.
Autorouter v1.23 masih satu layer per koneksi; mid-route via/layer switching dan inner-layer production routing belum diklaim.
Assistant menampilkan status AI Gateway dan Tes AI nyata yang memaksa request LLM.
Silabus Profesional PCB 2026–2027 ditambahkan ke Learning Atlas dan RAG assistant.
en: Hover help and the Features & Errors catalog explain feature purpose, usage, error meaning, causes, and fixes.
Preview-first Auto Route uses the actual netlist/pad geometry with all/one-net scope, 1–2 layers, speed/completion strategy, and DRC review.
The v1.23 autorouter still uses one layer per connection; mid-route via/layer switching and production inner-layer routing are not claimed.
Assistant exposes AI Gateway status and a Real AI test that forces an LLM request.
Professional PCB Syllabus 2026–2027 is merged into Learning Atlas and assistant RAG.

title.id: PCB Workspace Layout Repair — command dock tanpa overlap
title.en: PCB Workspace Layout Repair — non-overlapping command dock

id: Board HUD dan FIELD PCB HUD dipindahkan dari overlay absolute ke command dock yang mengambil ruang layout sendiri.
Route/Via/Zone/Keepout memakai toolbar utama sebagai source-of-truth agar kontrol tidak ganda.
Advanced dock hanya memuat mode/net/layer/Diff Pair/Stack/Adv DRC; board dock hanya memuat Edge.Cuts/status routing.
Layout sempit memakai horizontal scroll sehingga canvas tidak tertutup control panel.
en: Board HUD and FIELD PCB HUD moved from absolute overlays into a command dock with its own layout space.
Route/Via/Zone/Keepout use the main toolbar as the source of truth to eliminate duplicate controls.
Advanced dock contains mode/net/layer/Diff Pair/Stack/Adv DRC; board dock contains Edge.Cuts/routing status.
Narrow layouts use horizontal scrolling so controls do not cover the canvas.

id: Audit source-of-truth lintas components, wires, nets, PCB tracks, placements, pads, vias, zones, diff-pairs, rules, dan manufacturing state.
Deteksi duplicate ref/ID, orphan endpoint, pin di luar pinCount, track/net mismatch, stale placements, orphan via/zone net, dan stale diff-pair.
Repair mode hanya menghapus stale wire/track yang aman dibuktikan invalid.
Project fingerprint SHA-256 untuk snapshot source-of-truth.
Physical DRC terkalibrasi mm: track width, copper clearance, via diameter/drill, annular ring, via-track, via-via, copper-edge, dan Edge.Cuts self-intersection.
Manufacturing preflight sekarang diblokir jika physical DRC menemukan pelanggaran.
en: Cross-engine source-of-truth audit across components, wires, nets, PCB tracks, placements, pads, vias, zones, diff pairs, rules, and manufacturing state.
Detects duplicate refs/IDs, orphan endpoints, pins beyond pinCount, track/net mismatch, stale placements, orphan via/zone nets, and stale diff pairs.
Repair mode only removes stale wires/tracks that are provably invalid.
SHA-256 project fingerprint for source-of-truth snapshots.
Calibrated physical DRC in mm: track width, copper clearance, via diameter/drill, annular ring, via-track, via-via, copper-edge, and Edge.Cuts self-intersection.
Manufacturing preflight is now blocked when physical DRC finds violations.

title.id: Manufacturing + 3D Geometry — CAM export dan geometry persistence
title.en: Manufacturing + 3D Geometry — CAM export and geometry persistence

id: PCB board model menyimpan track endpoints, pad positions, component placements, dan world size agar geometry bisa dipakai lintas tab.
Manufacturing engine menghasilkan Gerber RS-274X untuk F.Cu/B.Cu/Edge.Cuts, Excellon via drill, BOM, CPL, ZIP, SHA-256 manifest, dan release classification.
CAM export wajib memakai dimensi fisik board yang dimasukkan user; skala visual canvas tidak diperlakukan sebagai ukuran mekanik.
Tanpa verified physical footprint-pad geometry, output diberi kelas ENGINEERING-DRAFT-NOT-FOR-FABRICATION dan tidak diklaim siap pabrik.
3D viewer membaca outline/copper/via/placement project aktual dengan orbit, zoom, reset, dan PNG snapshot.
Body komponen 3D tetap placement proxy sampai STEP/body geometry terverifikasi tersedia.
Typed Command Bus dan System Health mencakup manufacturing preflight/export serta 3D geometry actions.
Encrypted project persistence kini menyimpan CAM calibration bersama board/professional state.
en: PCB board model now persists track endpoints, pad positions, component placements, and world size for cross-view geometry use.
Manufacturing engine generates Gerber RS-274X F.Cu/B.Cu/Edge.Cuts, Excellon via drill, BOM, CPL, ZIP, SHA-256 manifest, and release classification.
CAM export requires user-provided physical board dimensions; visual canvas scale is not treated as mechanical scale.
Without verified physical footprint-pad geometry, output is classified ENGINEERING-DRAFT-NOT-FOR-FABRICATION and is not claimed fabrication-ready.
3D viewer reads the actual project outline/copper/vias/placements with orbit, zoom, reset, and PNG snapshot.
3D component bodies remain placement proxies until verified STEP/body geometry is available.
Typed Command Bus and System Health now cover manufacturing preflight/export and 3D geometry actions.
Encrypted project persistence now stores CAM calibration alongside board/professional state.

title.id: Stability & Integration Pass — real engine bridges + self-test
title.en: Stability & Integration Pass — real engine bridges + self-test

id: Core workspace v1.19.0 menghubungkan ERC, PCB DRC, Live Circuit, Route/Via/Zone, Project Database dan Professional Rules ke engine yang benar-benar tersedia.
Hapus fake schematic wire, fake ratsnest, decorative 3D board dan angka simulasi ilustratif agar data engineering palsu tidak muncul saat engine belum siap.
Perbaiki encrypted autosave fingerprint agar capturedAt tidak membuat revision database baru tanpa perubahan desain.
Tombol New membuat cloud project baru tanpa menimpa remote project lama; Backup key sekarang punya Import key untuk recovery browser.
Full project snapshot mengambil component metadata, live nets/wires, PCB geometry, advanced board, professional profile, workflow dan database state.
Extended component metadata dipertahankan dan divalidasi saat import.

Tambah HEALTH / System Health self-test serta endpoint /api/health untuk engine presence, database, professional evidence, command validator, fake-value guard, runtime errors, server health dan AI-auth status.
Pipeline produksi sekarang wajib lolos strict Svelte check, unit/runtime regression tests, dan production build.
en: Core workspace v1.19.0 connects ERC, PCB DRC, Live Circuit, Route/Via/Zone, Project Database, and Professional Rules to the actually available engines.
Removed fake schematic wires, fake ratsnest, decorative 3D board, and illustrative simulation values so fabricated engineering data is not shown when engines are unavailable.
Fixed encrypted autosave fingerprinting so capturedAt no longer creates database revisions without design changes.
New creates a separate cloud project without overwriting the previous remote project; Backup key now has Import key for browser recovery.
Full project snapshot captures component metadata, live nets/wires, PCB geometry, advanced board state, professional profile, workflow, and database state.
Extended component metadata is preserved and validated on import.
Added HEALTH / System Health self-test plus /api/health for engine presence, database, professional evidence, command validation, fake-value guard, runtime errors, server health, and AI-auth status.
Production pipeline must now pass strict Svelte check, unit/runtime regression tests, and production build.

title.id: Professional Engineering Baseline — China EDA + Evidence
title.en: Professional Engineering Baseline — China EDA + Evidence

id: Tambah tombol PRO dan Professional Design & Evidence Center: Audit, Rules/DFM, SI/Timing, jurnal 5 tahun, Patent Watch, benchmark tools China, dan Upgrade Map.
Benchmark publik memakai EasyEDA Pro/JLCEDA Pro dan JLCPCB tanpa menyalin code/UI proprietary.
Tambah DFM profiles Safe Prototype, JLCPCB Conservative 1 oz, dan JLCPCB Capability Edge 1 oz.
PCB DRC membaca minimum track width profile; Advanced DRC membaca minimum via diameter/drill profile.
Tambah impedance/timing screening calculator dengan penandaan tegas bahwa hasil bukan sign-off.
Supabase evidence library saat ini berisi 12 sumber riset 2022–2025, 7 patent-awareness records, dan 4 reference-tool records yang metadata sumbernya diverifikasi.
Assistant RAG ikut memakai professional evidence agar LLM tidak berdiri sendiri.
Database dirancang untuk berkembang ke 100k+ metadata DOI, tetapi release ini tidak mengklaim 100.000 paper sudah dibaca atau diverifikasi.
Urutan upgrade profesional dikunci: central domain model → full geometry DRC/DFM → Gerber/Drill/CAM → high-speed SI/PI/thermal → AI optimization/digital twin.
en: Added the PRO button and Professional Design & Evidence Center: Audit, Rules/DFM, SI/Timing, five-year research, Patent Watch, Chinese-tool benchmarks, and Upgrade Map.
Public benchmarking uses EasyEDA Pro/JLCEDA Pro and JLCPCB without copying proprietary code/UI.
Added Safe Prototype, JLCPCB Conservative 1 oz, and JLCPCB Capability Edge 1 oz DFM profiles.
PCB DRC reads profile minimum track width; Advanced DRC reads profile minimum via diameter/drill.
Added impedance/timing screening calculations with explicit non-sign-off labeling.
The Supabase evidence library currently contains 12 research records from 2022–2025, 7 patent-awareness records, and 4 verified reference-tool records.
Assistant RAG now consumes professional evidence so the LLM is not reasoning in isolation.
The database is designed to scale toward 100k+ DOI metadata records, but this release does not claim 100,000 papers were already read or verified.
Professional upgrade order is locked: central domain model → full geometry DRC/DFM → Gerber/Drill/CAM → high-speed SI/PI/thermal → AI optimization/digital twin.

title.id: Encrypted Project Database — Supabase + AES-GCM + RLS
title.en: Encrypted Project Database — Supabase + AES-GCM + RLS

id: Buat Supabase khusus PCBPro0045 di ap-southeast-1 dan pisahkan dari ArenaBook.
Tambah pcb_projects + pcb_project_versions dengan RLS berbasis owner-token hash.
Project name dan payload dienkripsi AES-GCM di browser sebelum upload.
Tambah transactional save RPC dan revision history sampai 50 snapshot.
Project tab mendapat panel database terenkripsi, daftar project remote, Sync sekarang, + Proyek DB, dan Backup key.
Current local project otomatis disimpan ke database saat database pertama kali kosong; perubahan berikutnya autosync.
Restore database mengembalikan components, UI state, wiring, PCB geometry, dan advanced board state.
Security advisor Supabase dibersihkan: function search_path sudah di-hardening.
en: Created a dedicated PCBPro0045 Supabase project in ap-southeast-1, separate from ArenaBook.
Added pcb_projects and pcb_project_versions with owner-token-hash RLS.
Project names and payloads are AES-GCM encrypted in the browser before upload.
Added transactional save RPC and up to 50 revision snapshots.
The Project tab gets an encrypted-database panel, remote project list, Sync now, + DB project, and Backup key.
The current local project is automatically stored when the database is empty; later changes autosync.
Database restore brings back components, UI state, wiring, PCB geometry, and advanced board state.
Supabase security advisor is clean after hardening function search paths.

id: Component Library diperluas menjadi sekitar 1.484 entry termasuk 1.472 entry baru plus 12 core parts.
Tambah kategori Audio, Raspberry Pi, MCU, wireless, sensor, power, logic, analog, connector, motor/driver, display, memory, protection, timing, passives, dan lainnya.
Catalog memakai pencarian, filter kategori, lazy load, dan Load More untuk menjaga performa.
Generic template tidak mengarang rating; exact part identifier tetap perlu datasheet/package verification.
Wire Engine dan PCB pad engine membaca pin-count metadata dari catalog bila tersedia.
Extended catalog diindeks oleh local RAG assistant agar pencarian komponen bisa dilakukan tanpa selalu memakai token LLM.
en: Expanded the Component Library to roughly 1,484 entries, including 1,472 new entries plus the 12 core parts.
Added Audio, Raspberry Pi, MCU, wireless, sensor, power, logic, analog, connector, motor/driver, display, memory, protection, timing, passive, and other categories.
The catalog uses search, category filtering, lazy loading, and Load More to preserve performance.
Generic templates do not invent ratings; exact part identifiers still require datasheet/package verification.
The Wire Engine and PCB pad engine read catalog pin-count metadata when available.
The extended catalog is indexed by the assistant local RAG so component lookup does not always spend LLM tokens.

id: Workflow disesuaikan dengan tutorial KiCad yang diberikan user: buat schematic, tambah/edit komponen, wiring, Move/Drag, annotation, footprint assignment, ERC, pindah ke PCB, placement, routing, layer atas/bawah, Edge.Cuts, DRC, dan 3D/fabrication sebagai tahap lanjutan.

Tambah hotkey perilaku KiCad: W untuk Wire, M untuk Move yang melepas koneksi pin, G untuk Drag yang mempertahankan wire, R rotate, E/V edit value, F footprint picker, serta klik kanan drag untuk pan.
Tambah KiCad Flow bar pada schematic dengan aksi Wire, Annotation, Footprint, ERC, dan pindah ke PCB.
Annotation sekarang merapikan RefDes per prefix dan ikut memigrasikan referensi pin pada wire graph.
Footprint picker menampilkan preset fisik umum dan tetap meminta verifikasi pitch/pin/dimensi terhadap datasheet nyata.
PCB workspace sekarang punya model geometri persisten untuk track, ratsnest dari netlist schematic, layer F.Cu/B.Cu, manual Edge.Cuts polygon, dan basic geometry DRC.
Route hanya boleh menyambungkan pad yang berada pada net schematic yang sama; koneksi lintas net ditolak agar tidak membuat short palsu.

Basic PCB DRC memeriksa koneksi yang belum diroute, Edge.Cuts, footprint di luar outline, serta crossing copper antar-net pada layer yang sama. Manufacturing-grade clearance/drill/zone DRC masih belum diklaim selesai.
Workflow readiness sekarang membaca geometri board nyata dari PCB engine; routing dan outline tidak lagi dianggap selesai hanya karena tombol UI ditekan.
en: The workflow is aligned to the user-provided KiCad tutorial: schematic creation, component editing, wiring, Move/Drag, annotation, footprint assignment, ERC, PCB transfer, placement, routing, top/bottom layers, Edge.Cuts, DRC, with 3D/fabrication as later stages.

Added KiCad-like interaction hotkeys: W for Wire, M for Move that detaches pin connections, G for Drag that preserves wires, R rotate, E/V edit value, F footprint picker, plus right-button drag for pan.
Added a KiCad Flow bar on the schematic with Wire, Annotation, Footprint, ERC, and PCB actions.
Annotation now normalizes RefDes numbering by prefix and migrates pin references in the wire graph.
The footprint picker offers common physical presets while still requiring pitch/pin/dimension verification against the real datasheet.
The PCB workspace now has a persistent geometry model for tracks, schematic-net-derived ratsnest, F.Cu/B.Cu layers, manual Edge.Cuts polygons, and basic geometry DRC.
Routing only allows pads belonging to the same schematic net; cross-net connections are rejected instead of creating fake shorts.

Basic PCB DRC checks unrouted connectivity, Edge.Cuts, footprints outside the outline, and same-layer cross-net copper crossings. Manufacturing-grade clearance/drill/zone DRC is not claimed complete yet.
Workflow readiness now reads actual board geometry from the PCB engine; routing and outline are no longer considered complete just because a UI button was pressed.

title.id: Wire Engine v2 — Stable Pin Layer
title.en: Wire Engine v2 — Stable Pin Layer

id: Wire engine dibangun ulang memakai pin layer terpisah dari DOM komponen supaya klik pin tidak bentrok dengan drag/select komponen Svelte.
Posisi pin dihitung dari geometri komponen aktual di workspace, lalu wire endpoint mengikuti posisi komponen saat dipindahkan, zoom, pan, atau layout berubah.
Graph wiring lama dimigrasi ke schema v2, divalidasi terhadap pin yang benar-benar ada, lalu koneksi duplikat, self-loop, dan stale otomatis dibuang.
Wire mode mendukung preview live, corner orthogonal, klik pin-ke-pin, pilih wire, Delete/Backspace, Esc, dan Reset Wiring.
Net Inspector disinkronkan dari wire graph v2 dan perubahan netlist langsung dipublikasikan ke simulator serta assistant.
Runtime loader memakai asset wire versioned supaya browser tidak terus menjalankan wire-engine lama dari cache.
en: The wire engine was rebuilt around a separate pin layer so pin clicks no longer conflict with Svelte component drag/select handling.
Pin positions are derived from actual component geometry; wire endpoints follow components through movement, zoom, pan, and layout changes.
Legacy wiring graphs are migrated to schema v2, validated against pins that actually exist, and stale, duplicate, or self-loop connections are removed.
Wire mode supports live preview, orthogonal corners, pin-to-pin completion, wire selection, Delete/Backspace, Escape, and Reset Wiring.
Net Inspector is synchronized from the v2 wire graph and netlist changes are immediately published to the simulator and assistant.
The runtime loader now requests a versioned wire asset so browsers do not keep running an older cached wire engine.

id: Workspace utama sekarang diberi frame/card yang jelas dengan padding, border, dan overflow yang terkontrol agar canvas tidak terlihat terpotong atau menyatu dengan panel lain.
Inspector dan library mendapat ruang bawah serta scroll gutter supaya konten terakhir tetap bisa dijangkau pada layar laptop pendek.
Tambah tiga mode layout: Fleksibel, Fokus Canvas, dan Fokus Inspector tanpa menghapus kemampuan panel resize yang sudah ada.
Kontrol ID/EN, ukuran UI, Comfort, dan Update tidak lagi menutup inspector secara permanen; sekarang dibuka dari tombol UI di top bar.
Launcher AI dipindah ke top bar sehingga tidak lagi menutupi data komponen/inspector di kanan bawah.

Berkas/Edit/Tampilan/Tempatkan/Jalur/Periksa/Alat/Produksi sekarang punya aksi/menu yang benar-benar bisa dipakai; tombol fitur yang engine-nya belum nyata diberi status unavailable, bukan dibiarkan terlihat aktif tetapi kosong.
New sekarang membuat project kosong yang nyata, sedangkan Export mengambil wire graph/netlist aktif, bukan netlist demo hardcoded.

Angka DRC/routing dan operating-point placeholder yang belum didukung engine nyata tidak lagi dipresentasikan sebagai hasil valid; simulator placeholder disembunyikan saat menunggu Live Circuit Solver.
Design Checks sekarang mengambil ERC dasar dari workflow state aktual dan DRC PCB ditandai menunggu geometry engine, bukan clean/finding palsu.
en: The main workspace now has a clear framed/card surface with controlled padding, borders, and overflow so the canvas no longer looks clipped into adjacent panels.
Inspector and library panels receive bottom breathing room and stable scroll gutters so their final content remains reachable on shorter laptop displays.
Added three layout modes: Flexible, Canvas Focus, and Inspector Focus while preserving the existing resizable-panel workflow.
ID/EN, UI size, Comfort, and Updates no longer permanently cover the inspector; they are opened from a UI button in the top bar.
The AI launcher is moved into the top bar so it no longer covers component data at the bottom-right.

File/Edit/View/Place/Route/Inspect/Tools/Manufacture now expose usable actions or menus; controls whose real engine is not implemented are explicitly marked unavailable instead of looking active but doing nothing.
New now creates an actually empty project, while Export uses the active wire graph/netlist instead of demo hardcoded nets.
Unsupported DRC/routing numbers and operating-point placeholders are no longer presented as valid results; simulator placeholders are hidden while the Live Circuit Solver loads.
Design Checks now derive Basic ERC from actual workflow state and PCB DRC is marked as waiting for the geometry engine instead of showing fake clean/finding results.

id: Tool Wire sekarang punya pin klik nyata di schematic. Klik pin pertama untuk mulai koneksi dan klik pin tujuan untuk menyelesaikannya.
Preview wire mengikuti mouse; klik area kosong menambahkan corner orthogonal 90 derajat.
Endpoint wire ditambatkan ke pin DOM sehingga saat komponen digeser, ujung wire tetap mengikuti komponen.
Wire graph disimpan ke localStorage dan menjadi sumber netlist dinamis; NET INSPECTOR disinkronkan dari koneksi yang benar-benar dibuat user.
Klik wire saat bukan mode Wire lalu tekan Delete/Backspace untuk memutus koneksi; perubahan netlist langsung dipublikasikan ke simulator/assistant.
Static demo wire disembunyikan. Project yang belum di-wire sekarang tampil benar-benar belum terkoneksi, bukan berpura-pura memiliki netlist.
en: The Wire tool now exposes real clickable schematic pins. Click a source pin to start and a destination pin to finish a connection.
Wire preview follows the pointer; clicking empty canvas adds orthogonal 90-degree corners.
Wire endpoints are anchored to component pin elements so moving a component keeps the wire attached.
The persistent wire graph now drives a dynamic netlist and synchronizes NET INSPECTOR from connections actually created by the user.
Select a wire outside Wire mode and press Delete/Backspace to break the connection; netlist changes are published immediately to simulator/assistant consumers.
Static demo wires are hidden. An unwired project is now honestly shown as electrically unconnected.

id: Tambah Workflow Center 16 tahap dari project, schematic capture, annotation, footprint, ERC, transfer ke PCB, Edge.Cuts, placement, routing, copper zone, DRC/preflight, Gerber/drill, CAM check, sampai handoff manufaktur.
Status tiap tahap dihitung dari project aktif; langkah tidak boleh ditandai selesai bila data/geometri yang diperlukan belum benar-benar tersedia.
Tambah Basic ERC yang memeriksa duplicate/invalid reference, GND, floating two-pin parts, dan footprint yang belum ditentukan.
Tambah export workflow/project snapshot JSON untuk audit dan debugging.
Copilot sekarang menerima workflow state sebagai context sehingga bisa menjawab 'langkah berikutnya apa', ERC, routing, Gerber, drill, dan manufacturing readiness berdasarkan kondisi project aktual.
Gerber, drill, CAM, routing geometry, copper zone, dan JLCPCB handoff tetap diblokir bila board geometry source-of-truth belum ada; tidak ada manufacturing output palsu.
en: Added a 16-stage Workflow Center from project setup, schematic capture, annotation, footprints, ERC, PCB transfer, Edge.Cuts, placement, routing, copper zones, DRC/preflight, Gerber/drill, CAM inspection, through manufacturing handoff.
Each stage is computed from the active project; a step cannot be marked complete when required data or geometry is not actually available.
Added Basic ERC checks for duplicate/invalid references, GND, floating two-pin parts, and missing footprints.
Added workflow/project snapshot JSON export for audit and debugging.
Copilot now receives workflow state so it can answer next-step, ERC, routing, Gerber, drill, and manufacturing-readiness questions from the actual project state.
Gerber, drill, CAM, routing geometry, copper zones, and JLCPCB handoff remain blocked until a real board-geometry source of truth exists; no fake manufacturing output is produced.

id: Copilot sekarang memakai backend LLM sungguhan melalui Vercel AI Gateway, dengan context project, netlist, hasil simulator, history percakapan, dan katalog komponen terverifikasi.
Jawaban tidak lagi bergantung pada regex/fallback berulang sebagai jalur utama. Fallback lokal hanya dipakai jika LLM benar-benar gagal diakses.
Primary Simulator diubah menjadi Live Circuit: Run, Pause, Step Solve, Reset, live node probes, device voltage/current/power, dan fault injection.
Live Simulator memakai solver MNA project yang sebenarnya; perangkat yang belum punya model dideteksi sebagai unsupported dan tidak diberi hasil palsu.
Monte Carlo / thermal Reality Lab dipindahkan menjadi Advanced Field Analysis, bukan lagi simulator utama.
Engine berat tetap lazy-load supaya workflow utama lebih ringan untuk laptop spesifikasi rendah.
en: Copilot now uses a real LLM backend through Vercel AI Gateway with project context, netlist, simulator results, conversation history, and the verified component catalog.
Answers no longer rely on repeating regex/fallback logic as the primary path. Local fallback is only used when the LLM cannot be reached.
The primary Simulator is now Live Circuit: Run, Pause, Step Solve, Reset, live node probes, device voltage/current/power, and fault injection.
Live Simulator uses the actual project MNA solver; devices without supported models are explicitly flagged instead of receiving fabricated results.
Monte Carlo / thermal Reality Lab is moved to Advanced Field Analysis instead of being the primary simulator.
Heavy engines remain lazy-loaded so the main workflow stays usable on lower-spec laptops.

id: Copilot tidak lagi pura-pura sebagai LLM penuh: status UI menyatakan backend model belum aktif pada versi ini.
Tambah grounded reasoning untuk pertanyaan wiring/wayar berdasarkan netlist project aktif, termasuk arti pin dasar untuk source, resistor, diode, dan LED.
Tambah component-db.json sebagai katalog vendor terverifikasi dengan provenance URL dan tanggal verifikasi; part generik tidak diberi rating lapangan palsu.
Wire overlay tidak lagi memakai CONNECTIONS hardcoded. Garis schematic diturunkan dari netlist aktif yang terlihat di inspector.
en: Copilot stopped presenting itself as a full LLM before the model backend was connected.
Added grounded wiring reasoning from the active project netlist, including basic pin semantics for sources, resistors, diodes, and LEDs.
Added component-db.json as a vendor-verified catalog with provenance URLs and verification date; generic parts receive no fabricated field ratings.
Wire overlay no longer uses hardcoded CONNECTIONS and is derived from the active netlist.

title.id: Readable UI, Bahasa, dan Component Intelligence
title.en: Readable UI, Language, and Component Intelligence

id: Comfort UI menjadi default: teks, tombol, tab, inspector, library, simulator, dan chat diperbesar agar tidak membuat mata cepat lelah.
Tambah pilihan Bahasa Indonesia / English yang tersimpan di browser.
Tambah kontrol ukuran antarmuka dan kontras yang lebih nyaman.
Tambah Component Intelligence: status model, capability, limit, package/variant warning, dan confidence untuk komponen yang dipilih.
Tambah Patch Updates di dalam aplikasi agar setiap perkembangan terlihat jelas.
Sumber komponen spesifik mulai dikunci ke referensi vendor; entri generik tidak lagi dianggap mempunyai rating pasti tanpa MPN/datasheet.
en: Comfort UI is now the default: larger text, controls, tabs, inspector, simulator, and assistant chat.
Added persistent Indonesian / English language selection.
Added UI size controls and a more comfortable contrast profile.
Added Component Intelligence: model status, capabilities, limits, package/variant warnings, and confidence for the selected part.
Added in-app Patch Updates so product progress is visible on every release.
Specific parts begin using vendor-grounded references; generic entries are no longer treated as having exact ratings without an MPN/datasheet.

id: Pointer Events + requestAnimationFrame untuk drag yang lebih ringan.
Panel resize, pan/zoom, undo/redo, dan placement yang lebih fleksibel.
en: Pointer Events + requestAnimationFrame for smoother movement.
Resizable panels, pan/zoom, undo/redo, and more flexible placement.

id: Monte Carlo, tolerance, electro-thermal iteration, source/trace droop, dan fault injection.
Field envelope menjadi analisis lanjutan setelah live solver.
en: Monte Carlo, tolerance, electro-thermal iteration, source/trace droop, and fault injection.
Field envelope is now an advanced analysis after the live solver.

id: Fondasi awal asisten membaca project aktif dan menjalankan aksi dasar workspace.
en: Initial assistant foundation for reading the active project and basic workspace actions.
